# Project best practices

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-indexes.py from each note's description: edit the notes, not this file. -->

## Notes

- [[checks-before-commit]] — tools/lint and what it checks (shellcheck, SPDX, markdownlint, Go, i18n); CI runs the same.
- [[code-comments]] — How comments are written: header blocks, why not what, comment size, citing vault notes as wikilinks, no TODOs.
- [[commits-and-branches]] — Conventional Commits, branch names, scopes, one change per commit.
- [[dependencies]] — When a new dependency is acceptable: lightweight first, licence check, CREDITS.md, vendoring, pinning.
- [[design-tokens]] — Palette tokens, contrast thresholds, 1280x720 grid, text sizes, TV safe area, fonts and wordmark generation.
- [[documentation]] — What lives in the vault and what stays in the code repository's READMEs.
- [[formatting]] — Indentation per file type, 100-column lines, UTF-8/LF (.editorconfig).
- [[license-headers]] — SPDX GPL-3.0-or-later header on every new source file.
- [[packaging]] — PKGBUILD rules: local sources and checksums, source-dirs, pkgrel bumps, clean chroot, kernel modules.
- [[sound-files]] — Format, loudness, licence and naming rules for interface sound files; one sound per press.
- [[testing-and-verification]] — How steps are verified: builder and test VMs, frontend-preview, fakes, real hardware batches, measurements.
- [[ui-patterns]] — Recurring interface rules: pickers, overflow opens the full list, Cancel first, no news for the user's own actions, navigation groups.
- [[ui-text-and-i18n]] — No literal UI text: Tr singleton, en.json + it.json in the same change, key naming, placeholders, error codes.
- [[writing-for-users]] — Interface wording: plain words for a TV seen from the sofa, no technical names, no error codes.
